title: mermaid shot glasses
text: mermaid shot glasses. I purchased one set of these (you get 2)  They hold liquid about the size of a shot - or would work for a liquor?  Maybe a morning OJ.  They are delicate - These are really cute... BUT.... when I took them out of the dishwasher.. I have a (crystal delicate wash cycle that use with all my double walled glass) they were both full of water - INSIDE.  After 2 days trying to drain them, I give up.  They are ruined.  I am going to throw them away.  Really disappointed.  They are so cute - but apparently poorly made.  I have included photos
